info.title: EcoThuGom Backend Completion APIs
info.description: Admin catalog/prices plus profile, saved addresses, order changes, timeline/receipt, private evidence, disputes and reports. All customer cancellations require ADMIN approval. Existing collection-workflow and payment specs document the earlier core lifecycle. Local-only contract; not published to Postman cloud.

post.summary: Find a distance-prioritized automobile route to the assigned order snapshot
post.description: COLLECTOR session + CSRF. Allowed in ASSIGNED, EN_ROUTE or ARRIVED; destination is loaded from the order, never supplied by the caller. Rechecks assignment after provider I/O. No order updates or storage of the origin. Public Valhalla routing prioritizes distance within map/engine constraints; estimated travel time is not live traffic.
